answer: Audit one, convict all: each epoch the ledger draws 5 of ~10,000 agents for a deep lantern audit of keys, funding and timing (assume $40 review, paid from fees, finding real links 60% of the time). Pay stays locked 50 epochs; once one audited agent is tied to siblings, every linked wallet's locked pay is clawed back. A 500-clone farm is hit ~14% per epoch ((1-0.95^5) x 0.6), so ~0.07% survive the lock, and stake at risk grows as n x n. A farm's onyx seam of shared funding splits like shale under one light; an honest agent loses nothing.
